about: Points with a known FEMA flood zone, checked on 2026-11-13 against FEMA's NFHL data (flood-hazard.parquet) and FEMA's live map service. The first six are street addresses; the others are points inside real polygons of zones no well-known address is known to sit in. script/flood_zone_fixture.py cuts the polygons around them into flood_zones_sample.parquet. live_differs says why FEMA's live map gives another answer.
